 MOUNT VERNON, Iowa — A homicide investigation is underway in Mount Vernon after a man was found dead in a home Friday night.
 The Mt. Vernon-Lisbon Police Department said officers were called to a home on 1st Avenue Northwest just after 7:30 p.m. When they got there, they found 20-year-old Carlos Tercero Giron of Atlanta, Georgia suffering from a gunshot wound.
 Police first announced the death investigation Saturday .
 BACKGROUND: Person dies after emergency response in Mount Vernon 
 Tercero Giron was pronounced dead after lifesaving efforts were made by first responders.
 Police said there's no threat to the public at this time. It's unclear if anyone has been taken into custody yet.
